titre: Suspicious or phishing email
symptomes: phishing email asking for password or payment; strange link or attachment; sender address looks fake
etapes: Do not click any link or open the attachment|Do not reply and never send your password|Use the Report Phishing button in Outlook or forward the email to security@company.example|Delete the email after reporting it|If you already clicked the link or typed your password: change your password now and tell the support
escalade_si: you clicked the link or entered your credentials
source: Microsoft Support : Report phishing and junk email messages in Outlook

titre: Antivirus alert or malware detected
symptomes: antivirus detected malware or virus; quarantine message; files behave strangely; pop-ups
etapes: Do not ignore the alert and do not turn off the antivirus|Disconnect the computer from the network: unplug the cable and turn Wi-Fi off (Win+A, Wi-Fi tile)|Open Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > Protection history, let it quarantine the file, then choose Scan options > Full scan > Scan now|Write down the name of the threat shown in Protection history|Do not copy files from this computer to a USB drive or a shared folder
escalade_si: ransomware message or files encrypted or the alert comes back after the scan
source: Microsoft Support : Virus and threat protection in the Windows Security app

titre: Unknown sign-in on your account
symptomes: login from unknown country or device; security alert email; someone logged into my account
etapes: From a trusted computer open https://mysignins.microsoft.com/security-info and change your password|On https://myaccount.microsoft.com choose Devices > Sign out everywhere|On the Security info page check that the Microsoft Authenticator method is listed and remove any phone you do not know|Open https://mysignins.microsoft.com and write down each sign-in you did not make (time, country, application)
escalade_si: always: the security team must review the sign-in
source: Microsoft Support : View your recent sign-in activity (mysignins.microsoft.com)

titre: Unknown USB drive or device
symptomes: found a USB stick; USB drive contains files flagged as malicious; unknown device plugged into my computer
etapes: Do not plug the device in; if it is connected, unplug it now|Do not open any file from it|Put the device in an envelope, write where and when you found it, and give it to the security team|If it was plugged in, run Windows Security > Virus & threat protection > Scan options > Full scan > Scan now
escalade_si: always: the security team must examine the device
source: Microsoft Support : Virus and threat protection in the Windows Security app

titre: Unknown program or remote access tool installed
symptomes: unknown remote access tool installed on my laptop; strange program appeared; browser homepage changed; endpoint protection quarantined a suspicious executable
etapes: Disconnect the computer from the network: unplug the cable and press the Wi-Fi tile in the Windows quick settings (Win+A) to turn it off|Do not type any password on this computer|Open Settings > Apps > Installed apps, sort by Install date and write down the name and date of the unknown program|Do not uninstall it yourself: the security team needs to see it
escalade_si: always: the security team must check the computer
source: Microsoft Support : Uninstall or remove apps and programs in Windows

titre: Lost or stolen laptop or phone
symptomes: laptop stolen; lost my phone with company email; company device lost on a trip
etapes: From another device open https://mysignins.microsoft.com/security-info and change your company password|On https://myaccount.microsoft.com choose Devices > Sign out everywhere|On https://myaccount.microsoft.com > Devices, select the lost device and choose Disable lost device|Note where and when the device was lost; if it was stolen, report it to the police and keep the report number
escalade_si: always: the security team must lock or wipe the device
source: Microsoft Support : Manage your devices in My Account

titre: Password found in a data breach
symptomes: my credentials were exposed in a leak; a breach notification mentions my work account; my login details are listed online; leaked password alert
etapes: Change your company password now: press Ctrl+Alt+Del and choose Change a password|If you used the same password anywhere else, change it there too|Check that two-factor authentication is on at https://mysignins.microsoft.com/security-info|Sign out of all sessions from your account security page
escalade_si: always: the security team must check the account for unknown sign-ins
source: Microsoft Support : Change or reset your Windows password ; Microsoft Support : Set up your Microsoft Authenticator app

titre: Suspicious message from a colleague's account
symptomes: a coworker's chat account sends odd links; message from a known contact that looks fake; unexpected file shared by a colleague in a chat
etapes: Do not click the link or open the file|Call or message the colleague by another channel to check|In Teams, select the message, then More options (...) > Report this message|Write down the time and the sender of the message
escalade_si: always: the security team must check the colleague's account
source: Microsoft Support : Report a security concern in Microsoft Teams

titre: VPN disconnects or does not connect
symptomes: VPN keeps disconnecting; VPN connection fails; cannot connect to VPN from home; remote access drops
etapes: Check that your home internet works: open https://www.bing.com without the VPN|Disconnect the VPN, then right-click the VPN icon in the taskbar tray and choose Exit (or Quit)|Start the VPN client again from the Start menu and connect|If you use Wi-Fi move closer to the router or plug in a network cable|Restart the computer (Start > Power > Restart) and connect once more
escalade_si: the VPN still drops after a restart and a cable connection

titre: Slow or unstable Wi-Fi
symptomes: Wi-Fi very slow; Wi-Fi drops every few minutes; weak signal in meeting room
etapes: Press Win+A and turn Wi-Fi off, wait 10 seconds, turn it on again|Open Settings > Network & internet > Wi-Fi > Manage known networks, select the office network, choose Forget, then reconnect with your credentials|Move closer to an access point or plug in a network cable|Ask colleagues in the same room whether their Wi-Fi drops too
escalade_si: several people in the same area have the problem
source: Microsoft Support : Fix Wi-Fi connection issues in Windows

titre: No network or intranet not reachable
symptomes: no network connection; DNS lookup fails; cannot reach the intranet; remote desktop connection times out
etapes: Check that the network cable is plugged in on both ends|Restart the computer|Open a public website to see if only the intranet is affected|Run ipconfig /flushdns in a command prompt then retry
escalade_si: the whole office or a whole department has no network
source: Microsoft Learn : ipconfig (learn.microsoft.com/windows-server/administration/windows-commands/ipconfig)

titre: Wired Ethernet connection does not work
symptomes: Ethernet connection stopped working after I moved desks; network cable not working; unidentified network on the wired adapter; no internet on the cable
etapes: Check that the cable clicks into the computer and the wall port|Try another wall port or another cable|Look for the link light next to the network port|Disable and enable the network adapter in Settings > Network|Restart the computer
escalade_si: no wall port works at your desk

titre: Mapped network drive disconnected
symptomes: mapped network drive shows a red cross; network path not found; shared drive letter disappeared
etapes: If you work remotely connect the VPN first|Open File Explorer and type the server path (for example \\server\share)|Right-click the drive and choose Disconnect then map it again|Restart the computer to reconnect the drives at sign-in
escalade_si: colleagues cannot reach the same drive either

titre: Slow internet or laggy video calls
symptomes: internet very slow; downloads take forever; video calls freeze and lag; high latency from home
etapes: Run a speed test on https://www.speedtest.net and write down the download, upload and ping values|Open Task Manager (Ctrl+Shift+Esc) > Performance > Ethernet or Wi-Fi to see whether another program uses the connection; pause OneDrive and large downloads|At home unplug the router, wait two minutes, plug it in again|Plug in a network cable, or move closer to the Wi-Fi router, and run the speed test again|Ask colleagues whether they have the same problem
escalade_si: the speed stays very low on a cable connection

titre: Connected to Wi-Fi but no internet
symptomes: wireless says connected but pages do not load; the network icon shows a globe or a yellow warning; browsers say no connection while the Wi-Fi is on
etapes: Open a command prompt and run ipconfig /release then ipconfig /renew|Check Settings > Network & internet > Proxy: automatic detection on, no manual proxy unless IT set it|Forget the network and connect again|If it still fails, run Settings > Network & internet > Advanced network settings > Network reset, then restart
escalade_si: several people on the same network have no internet
source: Microsoft Learn : ipconfig (learn.microsoft.com/windows-server/administration/windows-commands/ipconfig) ; Microsoft Support : Fix Wi-Fi connection issues in Windows

titre: Internal site name cannot be resolved (DNS)
symptomes: internal web addresses are not found; the browser cannot find the server name of intranet pages; name resolution error for company sites
etapes: If you work remotely, check that the VPN is connected|Run ipconfig /flushdns in a command prompt|Run nslookup followed by the site name and note the answer|Restart the browser and try again
escalade_si: nslookup does not find the internal name while the VPN is connected
source: Microsoft Learn : ipconfig ; Microsoft Learn : nslookup (learn.microsoft.com/windows-server/administration/windows-commands/nslookup)

titre: Printer offline or not printing
symptomes: printer shows offline; nothing prints; print jobs stuck in the queue; scanner jams
etapes: Check that the printer is switched on and shows no error on its screen|Open the print queue and cancel the stuck jobs|Turn the printer off for 30 seconds and back on|Remove and add the printer again from Settings > Printers|For a paper jam open the trays and remove the paper gently
escalade_si: the printer shows a hardware error code or the jam comes back

titre: Laptop battery drains or overheats
symptomes: battery drains in one hour; charger gets hot; fan very loud; laptop overheats or is very slow
etapes: Close the applications you do not use and check the Task Manager for high CPU|Put the laptop on a hard flat surface so the air vents are free|Use the original charger and check the cable for damage|Restart the laptop and install pending updates
escalade_si: the battery swells or the charger or laptop is too hot to touch

titre: Monitor or keyboard does not work
symptomes: second monitor stays black; docking station; keys no longer respond; mouse not detected; wireless mouse or keyboard disconnects every few minutes; mouse pointer freezes
etapes: Unplug and plug again the cable of the monitor or keyboard|Try another port or another cable if you have one|Restart the computer while it is connected to the docking station|Press Windows+P and choose Extend for a second monitor
escalade_si: the device does not work on another computer either
source: Microsoft Support : How to use multiple monitors in Windows

titre: Webcam, microphone or headset not detected
symptomes: webcam not detected during video calls; camera not found by Teams; headset microphone not detected; no sound in the headset
etapes: Check the privacy shutter or the camera key, and the mute button of the headset|In the meeting app open Settings > Devices and choose the right camera and microphone|Unplug the device and plug it into another USB port|In Windows Settings > Privacy allow apps to use the camera and the microphone|Restart the computer
escalade_si: the device does not work on another computer either

titre: Scanner gives blank pages or does not scan
symptomes: scanner produces blank pages; scanned document is empty and white; scan to email never arrives; scanner does not start
etapes: Check which side of the document faces the glass or the feeder|Clean the scanner glass with a dry cloth|Choose the right source (glass or document feeder) in the scan settings|Turn the scanner off for 30 seconds and back on|Scan one test page
escalade_si: the test page is still blank

titre: Laptop does not turn on or does not charge
symptomes: laptop does not turn on; no power light; battery does not charge; docking station does not charge my laptop; desktop restarts or shuts down when I connect a USB device; workstation does not boot after a power cut
etapes: Plug the original charger directly into the laptop, without the docking station|Check that the charger light is on and try another wall socket|Hold the power button for 30 seconds, then press it once|Leave the laptop charging for 15 minutes before trying again
escalade_si: there is still no light with the original charger

titre: Screen flickers, shows lines or is cracked
symptomes: display shows horizontal lines; picture blinks on and off; broken laptop display; colours on the display look wrong
etapes: Connect an external monitor: if it works, the laptop screen itself is faulty|Update the display driver: Device Manager > Display adapters > right-click > Update driver|Press Windows+Ctrl+Shift+B to restart the graphics driver|For a cracked screen, stop using it and keep the laptop closed
escalade_si: the screen is cracked or the external monitor shows the same problem
source: Microsoft Support : Troubleshoot screen flickering in Windows

titre: Keyboard, mouse or touchpad not responding
symptomes: letters typed are not the ones on the keys; pointer moves on its own; trackpad ignores taps; bluetooth mouse loses its connection
etapes: Wrong characters: press Windows+Space to switch to the right keyboard layout|Touchpad: Settings > Bluetooth & devices > Touchpad must be on|Wireless mouse or keyboard: change the batteries, then remove and pair it again in Settings > Bluetooth & devices|Wired device: plug it into another USB port
escalade_si: the device does not work on another computer either
source: Microsoft Support : Troubleshoot touchpad problems in Windows

titre: Account locked after too many attempts
symptomes: account locked; too many password attempts; cannot log in
etapes: Wait 15 minutes: the lock is released automatically|Check that Caps Lock is off and that the keyboard layout in the bottom-right corner of the sign-in screen is the right one (ENG, FRA...)|Sign in again once with your current password|If you forgot your password open https://passwordreset.microsoftonline.com from another device and follow the steps
escalade_si: the account is still locked after 15 minutes
source: Microsoft Support : Reset your work or school password

titre: Password expired or reset link not working
symptomes: password expired; reset link does not work; cannot change password
etapes: Open https://passwordreset.microsoftonline.com in a private browser window (Ctrl+Shift+N)|Request a new reset link: only the latest link is valid|Choose a password that follows the policy (12 characters at least)|Update the saved password on your phone (Settings > Mail accounts) and other devices
escalade_si: the reset page shows an error twice
source: Microsoft Support : Reset your work or school password

titre: Permission denied on a folder or application
symptomes: permission denied on shared drive; no access to CRM or HR portal; new employee has no access; two-factor codes rejected
etapes: Check that you are signed in with your own account: press Ctrl+Alt+Del, the account name is shown at the top|Sign out (Start > your name > Sign out) and sign in again so your group membership is refreshed|Note the exact path or address you cannot open (for example \\server\share\folder) and ask your manager to confirm the access you need|For rejected two-factor codes open Settings > Date & time on your phone and turn on Set time automatically
escalade_si: you need a new access right: the request must be approved by an administrator

titre: Two-factor authentication after a new phone
symptomes: authenticator app stopped working after I changed phones; MFA codes rejected on the new phone; lost phone with the authenticator
etapes: On the new phone open Settings > Date & time and turn on Set time automatically|Sign in with a backup method (text message or backup code) if you set one|From your computer open https://mysignins.microsoft.com/security-info, choose Add sign-in method > Authenticator app and scan the QR code with the new phone|On the same page delete the old phone from the list of methods
escalade_si: you have no backup method: the identity team must reset two-factor authentication
source: Microsoft Support : Set up your Microsoft Authenticator app

titre: Mailbox or shared mailbox not accessible
symptomes: cannot open the shared mailbox of my team; mailbox access lost after a department transfer; delegate access to a mailbox missing
etapes: Restart Outlook: a new shared mailbox can take up to one hour to appear|Open the mailbox in webmail to see if the access works there|Add the mailbox manually in File > Account settings > More settings > Advanced|Ask the mailbox owner to confirm that you were added
escalade_si: the access was never granted: the owner must request it

titre: Sign-in to an application fails
symptomes: I can log in to Windows but not to the application; single sign-on error; unauthorized error when opening the intranet; sign-in page keeps looping
etapes: Sign out of the application and sign in again|Open the application in a private browser window (Ctrl+Shift+N in Edge or Chrome)|Clear the cookies of this site: Edge > Settings > Cookies and site permissions > Manage and delete cookies > See all cookies|Check the time of your computer: Settings > Time & language > Date & time > Sync now|Try another browser
escalade_si: the error stays in a private window: your account may need the access right

titre: Request access to a SharePoint site, Teams or shared file
symptomes: the site owner must give me access; message saying I need permission for a document; cannot open a document someone shared with me
etapes: Check that you are signed in with your company account (picture at the top right)|On the access denied page, click Request access and explain why you need it|Ask the owner of the site or file to approve the request|Open the link again once you receive the approval email
escalade_si: the owner approved the access but it still does not work after one hour
source: Microsoft Support : Request access to a site or file in SharePoint

titre: New account or administrator rights
symptomes: a newcomer needs credentials before the first day; request a user account for a trainee; I need local administrator rights to install software
etapes: Ask your manager to submit the new account request in the IT portal at least one business day before the start date|Give the full name, the department and the start date|For administrator rights, explain which software you need: IT can often install it for you|A temporary password is sent to the manager, never by email to the new employee
escalade_si: always: accounts and administrator rights are created by the identity team

titre: Charged twice or wrong invoice amount
symptomes: charged twice; invoice shows the wrong amount; bill includes a service never ordered
etapes: Sign in to the billing portal, open Invoices and download the invoice as PDF|Download the bank or card statement that shows the payments for the same period|Write down the invoice number, the period and each amount that is wrong|Attach both documents to the ticket so the billing team can correct the invoice
escalade_si: always: refunds and corrections are made by the billing team

titre: Card payment declined
symptomes: payment declined; card payment refused; subscription renewal failed
etapes: In the billing portal open Payment methods and check the card expiry date and the billing address|Call your bank or open its app and ask whether the payment was blocked as suspicious|Try the payment again once only (Billing portal > Invoices > Pay now) to avoid double charges|Choose another approved payment method under Payment methods if you have one
escalade_si: the payment is declined again with a valid card

titre: Refund or missing receipt
symptomes: need a refund for a cancelled licence; payment receipt never sent
etapes: Search your mailbox, the Junk Email folder included, for the receipt (search: receipt OR invoice)|In the billing portal open Payments, select the payment and choose Download receipt|For a refund write down the licence name, the order number and the cancellation date, and attach them to the ticket
escalade_si: always for a refund: only the billing team can issue it

titre: Charged for inactive users or too many licences
symptomes: charged for inactive employee licenses; too many licences on the invoice; licence count does not match our users
etapes: Export the list of assigned licences from the admin portal|Remove the licences of people who left|Note the invoice number and the licences that should not be billed|Attach the list when you answer the billing team
escalade_si: always: credits are issued by the billing team

titre: Wrong tax or billing address on the invoice
symptomes: invoice uses the wrong tax region; VAT number missing on the invoice; billing address is incorrect; tax amount on the invoice is wrong
etapes: Open the billing profile in the portal and check the address and the VAT number|Correct the profile: the next invoice uses the new details|Note the number of the invoice that is wrong|Ask for a corrected invoice if a past invoice must be changed
escalade_si: a past invoice must be corrected

titre: Payment shown as overdue although paid
symptomes: billing portal shows a payment as overdue even though it was paid; payment reminder received after paying; credit note issued but balance unchanged
etapes: Check the payment date: a bank transfer can take 3 to 5 business days|Find the bank reference of the payment|Upload the proof of payment in the billing portal|You can ignore the reminder for 5 business days
escalade_si: the payment is still overdue after 5 business days

titre: Invoice in the wrong currency or without purchase order number
symptomes: the bill shows a foreign currency; the PO reference is not printed on the bill; wrong company name printed on the bill; copy of a previous bill
etapes: Download the invoice from the billing portal: Invoices > select the month > Download PDF|Check the currency and the company name in Billing profile|Add the purchase order number in Billing profile > Purchase order: it appears on the next invoice|Ask for a corrected invoice and give the invoice number
escalade_si: a past invoice must be reissued

titre: Change the payment method or update an expired card
symptomes: the saved card is out of date; replace the card used for automatic renewal; switch to bank transfer payment
etapes: In the billing portal open Payment methods > Add a payment method|Set the new method as default|Delete the expired card|Retry the failed payment once from the Invoices page
escalade_si: the new card is refused too

titre: Application crashes after an update
symptomes: application crashes on startup; crash after update; installer fails with an error
etapes: Restart the computer to finish the update|Open the application again and note any error message|Run the repair option from Settings > Apps|Uninstall and reinstall the application from the Company Portal
escalade_si: the application still crashes after reinstalling
source: Microsoft Support : Repair apps and programs in Windows

titre: Outlook does not receive emails
symptomes: Outlook stopped receiving emails; emails stuck in outbox; mailbox not updating
etapes: Check the status bar: Outlook must say Connected|Click Send/Receive all folders|Restart Outlook in safe mode (outlook.exe /safe) and then normally|Check that your mailbox is not full and empty Deleted Items
escalade_si: colleagues do not receive your emails either or webmail shows the same problem
source: Microsoft Support : Open Outlook in safe mode

titre: Excel or Office freezes or shows an error
symptomes: Excel freezes; file with macros; error code on export; browser extension stopped working
etapes: Save your work and close the program|Open the file again with macros disabled|Install pending Office updates|Repair Office from Settings > Apps > Microsoft 365 > Modify
escalade_si: the file is damaged or the error code comes back after the repair
source: Microsoft Support : Repair an Office application

titre: Installation or update fails
symptomes: installer fails with error 1603; software update rolled back without completing; installation stops halfway; license activation wizard fails
etapes: Restart the computer and close all other applications|Install the software from the Company Portal rather than a downloaded file|Free at least 5 GB of disk space|Run the installation again and note the error code
escalade_si: the same error code comes back twice

titre: Meeting audio or screen sharing problems
symptomes: others cannot hear me in a meeting; no sound in Teams calls; cannot share my screen in a call; meeting app shows a black screen when sharing
etapes: Leave the meeting and join again|Check the speaker and the microphone chosen in the meeting settings|Close other apps that use the microphone or the camera|Update the meeting app and restart it
escalade_si: the problem happens in every meeting after the update

titre: A file does not open or the app closes when saving
symptomes: PDF editor closes when saving a file; file does not open; file opens in the wrong application; document says it is corrupted
etapes: Save a copy of the file on your computer and open the copy|Open the file with another application|Set the default app in Settings > Apps > Default apps|Restore a previous version from OneDrive or SharePoint (Version history)|Repair the application from Settings > Apps
escalade_si: the file stays damaged: a technician can restore it from a backup

titre: Outlook keeps asking for the password or search finds nothing
symptomes: Outlook prompts for credentials repeatedly; mail search returns no results; the password window keeps coming back in Outlook
etapes: Password prompts: close Outlook, open Credential Manager > Windows Credentials and remove the entries that start with MicrosoftOffice, then open Outlook and sign in again|Check File > Office Account: the account shown must be your company account; sign out and sign in again if it is another one|Search: File > Options > Search > Indexing Options > Advanced > Rebuild, then wait until indexing ends|Restart the computer
escalade_si: Outlook still asks for the password after removing the saved credentials
source: Microsoft Support : Outlook keeps prompting for password ; Microsoft Support : Fix Outlook search issues

titre: OneDrive does not sync
symptomes: files are not uploading to OneDrive; OneDrive shows sync errors; OneDrive icon shows a warning; sync stays pending
etapes: Click the OneDrive icon in the taskbar and check the message|Help & Settings > Resume syncing if it is paused|Check that the file name has no forbidden characters and the path is not too long|Reset OneDrive: press Windows+R and run %localappdata%\Microsoft\OneDrive\onedrive.exe /reset
escalade_si: files are missing on the OneDrive website too
source: Microsoft Support : Fix OneDrive sync problems ; Microsoft Support : Reset OneDrive

titre: Windows Update is stuck or fails
symptomes: the Windows Update screen does not progress; updates install then roll back; an error code appears in Windows Update
etapes: Restart the computer and let the update finish, plugged into power|Run Settings > System > Troubleshoot > Other troubleshooters > Windows Update|Open a command prompt as administrator and run sfc /scannow|Note the error code shown in Settings > Windows Update
escalade_si: the same error code comes back after the troubleshooter
source: Microsoft Support : Troubleshoot problems updating Windows ; Microsoft Learn : sfc

titre: A company service is down
symptomes: server down; website returns 500 error; service unavailable for everyone; portal down after maintenance
etapes: Open the IT status page (https://status.company.example) to see if the outage is already known|Ask a colleague whether the service works for them, and try from another browser (Edge or Chrome)|Do not restart servers or network devices yourself|Note the time when the problem started and copy the exact error message (for example HTTP 500 or 503)
escalade_si: always: an outage is handled by the operations team

titre: Email or file server unavailable
symptomes: email service unavailable for the whole office; file server unreachable for all departments
etapes: Open the IT status page (https://status.company.example) and the IT announcements channel in Teams|For email: open Outlook on the web (https://outlook.office.com) to see whether only the desktop app is affected|Save your work on your computer (Documents) until the file server is back|Do not send the same email many times: it stays in the Outbox and leaves when the service is back
escalade_si: always when several people are affected

titre: Business application out of service
symptomes: payment platform out of service; database server down; whole team blocked
etapes: Open the IT status page (https://status.company.example) and look for the application|Copy the exact error message and note the time it appeared|Tell your manager if the outage blocks a deadline
escalade_si: always: the incident must be escalated at once

titre: Nobody can sign in
symptomes: identity service unavailable company-wide; single sign-on down for everyone; nobody can log in to any application
etapes: Open the IT status page (https://status.company.example) and the Microsoft 365 service status (https://status.cloud.microsoft)|Do not reset your password: it will not help during an outage|Keep working offline on files saved on your computer (Documents)|Note the time and copy the exact error message (for example AADSTS error codes)
escalade_si: always: an outage is handled by the operations team

titre: Collaboration platform down
symptomes: enterprise collaboration platform down across the organization; SharePoint unavailable for everyone; chat and meetings down for all users
etapes: Open the Microsoft 365 service status (https://status.cloud.microsoft) and the IT status page (https://status.company.example)|Reach colleagues by phone or Outlook while Teams or SharePoint is down|Save your documents on your computer (Documents) until the service is back|Note the time when the problem started and the exact error message
escalade_si: always: the operations team must restore the service
source: Microsoft Support : How to check Microsoft 365 service health (status.cloud.microsoft)

titre: Central business service unavailable for everyone
symptomes: all branches report the central ERP service is unavailable; main business application down for every department; the company website is unavailable to customers
etapes: Open the IT status page (https://status.company.example) and look for the application|Ask a colleague in another office or department whether it works for them|Copy the exact error message and note the time it appeared|Tell your manager if the outage blocks a deadline
escalade_si: always: the incident must be escalated at once

titre: Phone system down
symptomes: desk phones have no dial tone anywhere; telephony is unavailable company-wide; no incoming calls in any office
etapes: Open the IT status page (https://status.company.example) to see if the phone outage is known|Use Teams calls or your mobile phone for urgent calls|Tell the reception so they can inform callers|Note the time when the phones stopped and whether you hear a dial tone
escalade_si: always: telephony outages are handled by the operations team

titre: Customer website or payment platform down
symptomes: clients report the shop cannot be reached; the checkout page fails for every client; the public booking site does not load
etapes: Open the public website in a private browser window (Ctrl+Shift+N) from your phone network to confirm it does not load|Note the exact error message, the page address and the time|Tell your manager so customers can be informed|Do not restart servers or change the website yourself
escalade_si: always: the incident must be escalated at once to the operations team
